ciFast.note: Fast verification reruns release, format, lint, unit, evaluation, build, and bundle gates after push.

ciDeep.note: Deep proof remains an explicit downstream repository workflow rather than being represented as local browser proof.

deploy.note: Deployment remains downstream of successful repository checks and merge.

liveProvider.note: Fresh opt-in Current Technology Policy proof finished 6/6 lesson kernels and 9/9 material families at 99/A with zero encoded findings, grounded its Agent answer in workspace source evidence, and preserved eight normalized source rows in the final ZIP.

manualHuman.note: No instructor, classroom, human-preference, accessibility-certification, universal factual-validity, paid-model parity, or adapter-superiority claim is made.

manualBrowser.note: Repeated real browser generation, all nine material tabs, the grounded Agent, and the single export action were inspected. The accepted archive has 63 entries—43 DOCX, 6 PPTX, and 1 XLSX—with no targeted policy-domain, evidence-binding, prerequisite, FAQ, clipping, punctuation, placeholder, or source-ledger defects.

claims.summary: Algi converts the requested lesson sequence into bounded lesson-level research plans before provider work begins.
The licensed provider cascade feeds a claim evidence graph that records provenance and evaluates authority, currency, relevance, entailment, and conflict before admission.
A protocol-versioned local project cache can reuse inspected lesson evidence without weakening the private-mode boundary.
Schema-complete composition and the shared compiler keep facts with their concepts, separate policy from laboratory language, and frame source claims without malformed definitions.
The Living Course Compiler exposes research through export as one build, and the Agent answers from the completed source-grounded workspace.
A real six-lesson Current Technology Policy browser run completed at 99/A with zero encoded findings and exported one valid, source-normalized 63-entry archive.
A frozen eight-course, three-arm research-first benchmark defines honest promotion rules while recording that paired viability evidence does not yet exist.
Gemma weights and adapter state remain unchanged; Algi, Scion, and compatible paid providers share evidence, compiler, Agent, quality, and export improvements.

carryForward.item: Record same-commit paired artifacts across all eight frozen courses and three architecture arms without changing the research-first ruler.
Promote selective Scion authoring only where it earns a measured quality gain inside the frozen source, latency, call, model-byte, and export contract.
Measure a compact semantic retriever against held-out paraphrase coverage before accepting its download and memory cost.
Broaden primary and open-educational provider coverage only with explicit access, license, attribution, stable identity, and browser behavior.
Add qualified instructor or classroom validation when it becomes available; do not relabel automated or AI-only review as human evidence.
